subject: the release Makefile builds the libraries; its public test is relinked from test.c and the installed cJSON.o on every trial

five unchanged public-API Unity programs (cjson_add, compare_tests, minify_tests, old_utils_tests, misc_utils_tests) link both installed objects; CJSON_TESTS_COMMON_H suppresses common.h's embedded cJSON.c, with cJSON.h, stdbool.h and string.h supplied explicitly

this is the public Makefile test plus 54 public-API Unity assertions, not the full CMake/private-helper Unity suite; CMake is unavailable and private helpers cannot test an independently compiled object
cJSON's numbers are doubles, and the back end refuses floating point, so these units are not expected to pass before the floating-point rung

both units stop in <math.h> before any of their own code is read: the driver defines __GNUC__ 14, so glibc uses GCC 14's built-in vector types, which the front end does not have. With those types supplied by hand the units refuse on floating point instead (cJSON.c: __builtin_nanf undeclared; cJSON_Utils.c: E3101, a function value that is neither an integer nor an object pointer)
adjustments.buildCommand:
(set -e
make
(
set -e
rm -f cJSON_test
make 'CJSON_TEST_SRC=test.c cJSON.o' static tests
for test in cjson_add compare_tests minify_tests old_utils_tests misc_utils_tests; do
  "${CC:-gcc-14}" -DCJSON_TESTS_COMMON_H -include ./cJSON.h -include stdbool.h -include string.h tests/$test.c tests/unity/src/unity.c cJSON.o cJSON_Utils.o -lm -o tests/$test
done
)
)
